data.additional_information:
To build the software backbone of our autonomous platforms — autonomy middleware, ground control software, mission planning, command-and-control, fleet management, and developer tooling. The role spans systems-level software, distributed systems, full-stack web/desktop applications, and the simulation infrastructure that powers our development cycle. PhD candidates will be considered for senior roles with ownership of an autonomy middleware, distributed systems, or formal methods workstream.

Job Responsibilities-
1. Build mission planning, command-and-control, and fleet-management interfaces. Frontend in C# / React / TypeScript with 3D map and video integration (Mapbox / WebRTC); backend in C#/ Go / Python / C++ with MAVLink / DDS bridges. 
2. Architect cloud / edge backends for telemetry ingestion, log analysis, OTA updates, and fleet operations. 
3. Build and maintain SITL / HITL pipelines, scenario generation, CI/CD for autonomy code, and reproducible test harnesses across Gazebo / Isaac Sim / proprietary simulators. 
4. Solve algorithmic problems at the heart of our products — graph search, geometric algorithms, optimization, scheduling, and concurrency primitives 
5. Drive code quality through unit, integration, and system tests. Build internal tooling for log replay, fault injection, and performance profiling on embedded targets. 
6. Work closely with autonomy, hardware, embedded, AI/ML, and field-test teams for software that runs reliably on real-world platforms in real-world conditions.

Skills Required-
1. Strong fundamentals in algorithms, data structures, operating systems, computer networks, and distributed systems.
2. Proficiency in modern C++ and Python. Familiarity with Go, Rust, or TypeScript and C# is a plus.
3. Hands-on experience with middleware and modern message-based architectures.
4. Comfortable with Linux, embedded Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD pipelines.
5. Working knowledge of databases and stream processing.
6. Frontend experience with React / TypeScript and 3D visualization (Cesium / Three.js) is a strong plus for GCS work.
7. Experience with formal methods, verification, or safety-critical software is desirable.

Educational Qualification-PhD/ M.Tech / M.Tech (Research)
Experience Required-0-2Years
data.additional_details:
Please find below the additional important details regarding our Company Clauses & Policies:

1.NDA – Non-Disclosure Agreement
Candidates must not disclose or share any confidential information related to their job role, projects, company operations, or work responsibilities with any external party. This clause will remain applicable for a lifetime.
2.NCC – Non-Compete Clause
Upon joining the company, when you decide to leave the organization in the future, you will not be eligible to join any direct competitor of the company for a period of 3 years post the last working day.
3.Minimum Service Agreement – 2 Years
Candidates from any branch having less than 2 Years of Experience are required to sign a mandatory 2-year Minimum Service Agreement. However, Candidates with more than 2 years of prior experience are exempted from the Minimum Service Agreement. Additionally breach of this agreement will result in a financial penalty of 40% of the CTC.
